# `Q-2-4` — Missing Space After Div Fence

> A div fence (`:::`) is missing the space the parser expects
> between the fence and its attribute list.

## What this means

A fenced div opens with three (or more) colons followed by
optional attributes:

```markdown
::: {.callout-note}
content
:::
```

The parser requires a space between the closing `:::` and the
attribute braces. This error fires when that space is missing —
for example `:::{.callout-note}` runs the fence and the
attributes together with no separator.

## Why this happens

A typo or an auto-format that closed the gap. Code generators
that assemble div fences from variables sometimes drop the
separator.

## How to fix

Insert a space between the colons and the attribute braces:

```markdown
::: {.callout-note}
content
:::
```
